Bug_Title: RANGE: String index is out of bounds (RANGE_STRING_INDEX)
Bug_Details: String method is called and specified string index is out of bounds. This will result in StringIndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by calling the charAt method on a string with an index that is equal to the length of the string. In Java, string indices are zero-based, so the valid indices for a string of length 5 are 0 to 4. Accessing index 5 results in a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a string 'Hello' and an index 5, which is out of bounds for the string.
